summary.text: Dan Woog, a Republican, has represented District 19 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Woog as advancing from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary and on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election; Woog previously represented House District 63 from 2021 to 2023.
Woog was born in Minneapolis, Minnesota, holds a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University (2005), and works in real estate.
